t1.text: E11 Talk for Mac — its own app, signed in and kept in step by your iPhone, every iPhone Talk feature

s1.text:
What's Apple's, what's ours

Apple's: the window, the glass sidebar the Mac app has today, the search field, the segmented control, the right-click menus (the iPhone's hold menus), the inspector, Quick Look, notifications, drag and drop, the share sheet.

Ours, as Talk on the iPhone: the bubbles, the chat background, the cards (task, E11 file/folder, link, album, file, voice), the reaction pill, the pinned bar, the orange client band.

Data: Talk's own — the iPhone hands over 90 days, then the Mac gets new messages itself.

s2.text:
EVERY TALK 137 FEATURE → ON THE MAC (nothing added)

LISTS: E11 Agency · Clients tabs · clients → their groups · All / Unread / Mentions · search (messages, the word marked) · unread counts · typing on the row · "With Client" · pin, mute (8 Hours / 1 Week / Always), mark read / unread (right-click) · new group (client, name, people, picture)

CHAT: text · @mentions · # tasks → task cards · links → preview cards · E11 file/folder links → live cards · photos & videos as albums (Photos / Files / Camera → send preview) · voice notes (record, play) · files · reply · reactions (palette, More Reactions) · who reacted · edit (15 min) · delete for everyone / for me · forward · copy · star · pin a message (pinned bar) · Message info (read by / delivered to) · ticks · client band · day chips · scroll to latest · search in the chat · the photo viewer (react, reply, share, forward, save, delete) · Open in E11 Console · sounds

GROUP INFO: picture (change / client logo) · name · description · search · Photos, Files and Links · mute · people: add, remove, Second Admin, Make Me Admin, drop admin · client contacts (add, sign-in code, remove — Super / Office Admins) · leave · delete

SETTINGS: Starred Messages · Client Contacts · Notifications · Storage and Data · Help · About · Sign out

IPHONE-ONLY by their nature (the Mac is linked to the phone): Chat Backup (the phone's iCloud), Linked Devices / Link a Device, Face ID sign-in.

CLIENT CONTACTS (as iPhone Talk's isContact): one list of their groups (no E11 Agency / Clients tabs, "3 groups · 2 unread", No Groups Yet) · no New Group · the chat's picture the E11 mark · no # tasks, no read ticks, no "With Client" · an E11 file / folder link a normal link card (no Open in E11 Console) · Settings without Client Contacts, profile "Client · <company>" + email · Group Info without the staff actions.

s3.text:
Decided (Haris 19:45–19:47):
• E11 Talk for Mac is independent of E11 Console: linking signs it in. The Mac shows a code, Talk on the iPhone scans it (Settings › Linked Devices › Link a Device), and the Mac is signed in as the iPhone's person — staff and client contacts alike. No sign-in pages, no Console needed on the Mac.
• The chats come from the iPhone, then stay in step (new messages, reactions, edits, deletes, reads on both). No iCloud restore, no Chat Backup on the Mac.
• Unlinked / signed out on the iPhone / 30 days without the iPhone opening Talk: the Mac is signed out, its chats removed.
• Server change needed: a link code without a signed-in Mac; once the iPhone confirms, the Mac gets its own key for that person.

Decided (Haris 19:55–19:58):
• The Mac checks staff or client contact and shows that person's views, exactly as iPhone Talk.
• Auto-download on the Mac, as WhatsApp: Settings › Storage and Data › Auto-download — Photos, Audio, Videos, Documents, each on / off, all on to start; what's off shows tap-to-download.
• iPhone Talk: Settings › Linked Devices shown to client contacts too, its line "Link E11 Talk for Mac…" (a change to locked Talk — yes given; made with the linking work).

Decided (Haris 20:45–21:09): the WhatsApp Mac app's sync — after linking the Mac stands on its own (new messages straight from the server, even with the iPhone off); what's done on one shows on the other; signed out when unlinked, signed out of Talk on the iPhone, removed, or 30 days without the iPhone opening Talk. The iPhone says "Link a Device" (a Windows app later fits). Server: on the test server, its own address talklink-test.e11hq.com. Startup as the iPhone's.

s4.text:
LISTS — checked against iPhone Talk 137 (Lists.swift)

STAFF · E11 Agency and Clients, each a list of clients: logo, name, "<group> · <who>: <message>" ("Nadia (Client)" for a client's words; someone typing in blue; "2 groups with the client" with no messages yet), time, unread, pin · PINNED / CLIENTS · the title's line "6 clients · 5 unread" · search (clients, and messages — the word marked) · All / Unread n / Mentions · right-click a client: Pin / Unpin (up to 5) · + New Group: E11 Agency for those who can make groups, Clients for Super / Office Admins.

A CLIENT · opened in the same column with ‹ (board C): its square logo, "3 groups with the client · 3 unread", "Search <client>’s groups", All / Unread / Mentions, its groups pinned first then newest · each group: picture, name, "With Client" (Clients tab), two lines of the newest message, ticks on yours, time, unread, muted, pinned · + New group for that client.

RIGHT-CLICK A GROUP: Mute › 8 Hours · 1 Week · Always (or Unmute) · Mark as Read / Unread · Pin / Unpin ("Pinned is full" at 5) · Group Info · trackpad swipes as the iPhone's: right Read / Unread, left Delete (the group's admins, asked first).

CLIENT CONTACT (board H): no sidebar — one list "E11 Agency", "3 groups · 2 unread", every group with the E11 mark, no With Client, no + · your photo top left opens Settings · No Groups Yet when empty.

EMPTY: Apple's own — No Unread Messages · No Mentions · No Client Groups Yet · No Results.

MAC BY ITS NATURE (said plainly): the search field always showing (no pull-down on a Mac); the chat side empty until a chat is picked.

FOUND WHILE CHECKING: the first C board showed groups straight in the Clients list — fixed to the iPhone's way (clients → their groups); its chat title was "Northline Motors · Launch campaign" — now just the group's name, as the iPhone. One question: iPhone Talk's search box says "Search clients" to a client contact too — keep it, or "Search" (board H)?

s5.text:
STARTUP — as iPhone Talk's (Splash.swift), Haris 2026-11-14: "the startup will be same as ios app"

Every start (S1): the Talk icon putting itself together, "Good evening, <first name>", today's date, the thin bar filling while the chats load from the Mac's own copy, then straight into the list. Light or dark as the Mac. Ours said plainly: "Click to skip" where the iPhone says "Tap to skip".

First start after linking (S2): the same screen with Apple's spinner and "Setting up your account" in the bar's place until the iPhone's chats are in — only then, never again on that Mac.

Not linked yet: the icon, then the Link screen (A).

s6.text:
THE CHAT — checked against iPhone Talk 137 (Chat.swift, Voice.swift, SendPreview.swift, Reactions.swift)

TOP: the group's picture (a client contact: the E11 mark), its name, the people (a client first as "Rania (Northline)", the team by full name, You last; a client contact: first names) · Search in this chat (Earlier / Later match, "2 of 5", words marked) · Group Info.
UNDER IT: "Client can see this group" (a client group, staff only) · the pinned message.

MESSAGES: the group's description card at the start · notes ("Daniel added Nadia", "You pinned a message") · day chips (Today, Yesterday, the weekday, the date) · names and roles on others' first message of a run ("Client" in orange) · text with @mentions · reply quotes · link cards · E11 file / folder cards with Open in E11 Console ›, Copy Link (staff; a client contact: a normal link card) · task cards (staff groups) · photo / video albums (+N) · files · voice messages · Forwarded · Edited · "This message was deleted" · reactions under the bubble · ✓ / ✓✓ / blue ✓✓ on yours (a client contact: no blue) · someone typing · Scroll to the latest with the count of new.

RIGHT-CLICK (the iPhone's hold): reactions palette + More Reactions · Reply · Copy · Copy Link / Open in E11 Console (E11 cards) · Forward · Pin · Star · Edit (yours, 15 min) · Info · Save / Share · Delete (for Everyone / for Me).

WRITING: + → Photos · Files · Camera, then the send preview · @ list of the group's people · # list of tasks (staff groups, never with a client) · reply bar ✕ · editing bar ✕ · "Message client" in a client group.

VOICE: record, pause, delete, send ("Slide to cancel" is the iPhone's finger — on the Mac: 🗑 and send, said plainly).

MAC BY ITS NATURE (said plainly): click the mic to start (the iPhone holds); Return sends, Shift-Return a new line; drop files or paste a photo into the chat → the send preview; Camera = the Mac's camera or Continuity Camera ("No camera here" if none).
